notes: Anthropic first-party API list prices, read on the official pricing page on the date above.
cache_multipliers apply to the model's input price: 5-minute cache write 1.25x, 1-hour cache write 2x, cache read 0.1x (0.025x on Claude Fable 5.1, set per model below).
Long context: Claude 4.6 and later models are billed at standard rates across the full 1M context window (same page, 'Long context pricing').
Fast mode (Opus 5): its own input/output prices; the cache multipliers stack on top (same page, 'Fast mode pricing').
inference_geo 'us' is billed 1.1x on every token category for Claude 4.6 and later (same page, 'Data residency').
Only models whose API ID is confirmed on the models overview page are listed. Any other model makes cost-meter stop with an error naming it: add it here from the official page, never guess.
